text:
elaine: Hey team :wave: planning a progressive traffic handoff for the batching-config change today. Window 16:00-17:30 UTC. Plan: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% over three 30m steps. Who can own smoke checks + rollback readiness?
vikram: I can take the smoke owner on the first two steps. Will monitor p50/p95 and error-rate.
tessa: I’ll be on-call for rollback exec and will keep a runbook open. Can you drop the exact rollout percentages and the metric thresholds we care about?
elaine: thanks @vikram @tessa. thresholds: p95 latency increase > 20% OR error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 2m triggers immediate halt. Also look at token-cost spike > 15%.
sam: I’ll run the smoke script and validate model outputs for regressions. I’ll post results in this thread. Can you confirm the infra slice mapping?
elaine: infra slices: eu-west -> slice A (0.5%), us-central -> slice B (2%), global fallback -> remaining. We’ll start with eu-west only for the first window.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job DPL-412 queued by elaine for 1799999000. Ramp plan loaded: [0.5, 2, 10] percents; step_duration: 1800s. Auto-rollback: disabled (manual) — ops to approve.
vikram: noted. I’ll run quick smoke checklist: 1) health-checks green 2) KV cache sanity 3) trace sampling for 1% of requests.
tessa: Rollback steps: 1) hit manual stop on deploy console 2) pin prior model version 3) drain in-flight requests via drain endpoint. I’ll stand by.
sam: Running smoke now -> small diff in p95 (+3%) and no errors, embedding outputs match baseline spot-checks. Posting logs in ops. :white_check_mark:
elaine: great, starting first 0.5% at 16:00 UTC. I’ll ping when we shift to 2% and again before 10%. If anyone sees the thresholds trip, call it out here and we’ll stop and rollback.
vikram: on it. I’ll also pre-open the rollback ticket to speed exec if needed.
tessa: ACK, ready for manual rollback.
elaine: thanks all — will update at 16:30 after the second step. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: Deploy DPL-412 progressed to step 1 (0.5%). Timestamp 1799999100.
sam: Step1 smoke OK. p95 unchanged, errors 0. No regressions seen in sample prompts.
elaine: proceeding to 2% at 16:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Deploy DPL-412 progressed to step 2 (2%). Timestamp 1799999260.
vikram: Step2: slight p95 drift (+12%) but under threshold. Observability dashboards look healthy.
elaine: holding 2% for full 30m, will only advance if metrics stay steady.
elaine: (final) metrics stable — promoting to 10% now. Thanks everyone for quick checks. Closing smoke ownership; tessa keep rollback ready for 30m.
elaine: closing thread — leaving notes in the release doc and tagging infra for follow-up. :tada:
